templates.name: basic_login_event
templates.hql_content:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dwd_login AS
SELECT
    ds,
    role_id,
    account_id,
    utdid,
    get_json_object(params, '$.zone_id') AS zone_id,
    get_json_object(params, '$.level') AS level,
    get_json_object(params, '$.ip') AS ip,
    get_json_object(params, '$.device_id') AS device_id
FROM ieu_ods.ods_all_view
WHERE ds = '${bizdate}'
  AND event = 'game.login';
templates.description: 基础登录事件模板,包含角色ID、账号ID、设备信息等基础字段
